hint.move: Move with W A S D (or the arrow keys).
hint.move.touch: Rest your thumb on the left half of the screen and drag to walk.
hint.attack: Hold the left mouse button on an enemy to keep attacking.
hint.attack.touch: Hold the big button to attack: it aims at the nearest enemy by itself.
hint.skills: Your skills (1, 2, 3…) hit harder than the basic attack: use them in every fight.
hint.skills.touch: Tap the round buttons to cast skills. Drag them to aim by hand.
hint.dodge: Red zones warn of a hit: dodge with the space bar.
hint.dodge.touch: Red zones warn of a hit: dodge with the circular-arrow button.
hint.loot: Press E next to loot to pick it up.
hint.loot.touch: Walk up to the loot and tap “Pick up” (or tap the item itself).
hint.potion: Low health: press Z to drink a potion.
hint.potion.touch: Low health: tap the green flask button to drink a potion.
hint.levelup: Level up! You have talent points: press T to spend them.
hint.levelup.touch: Level up! You have talent points: open ☰ → Talents.
hint.equip: There is a better item in your bag: press I and double-click it to equip it.
hint.equip.touch: There is a better item in your bag: ☰ → Bag, then double-tap it to equip.
